note: The two sets are nearly identical; A adds a supported through-bolt length of 4" while B adds a plywood thickness claim (supported) and a through-bolt diameter claim carrying the condition 'S-301', which appears nowhere on this sheet (the sheet is S-522). Both sets share the same questionable bindings (1" attributed to a 'nut sleeve' when the label is a 1" NUT with SLEVE as a separate item; 4 1/4" attributed to landscape footing width when it dimensions the rod/sleeve assembly in detail A6) and both repeat the 2"x8" and 3/4"x5 1/2" facts under two names. Because B introduces an invented condition and A introduces nothing unsupported, A is the better set.
remarks: Shared issues in both sets: 'nut sleeve | dimension | 1"' misreads the label '1" NUT / SLEVE' (1" is the nut size, sleeve is a separate part); 'landscape footing | component width | 4 1/4"' binds a dimension of the threaded-rod/sleeve assembly in detail A6 to the footing; 'decking footing plan | overall depth | 1'-0"' is a misbound/vague reading of a plan dimension. Both sets also state the 2"x8" joist/frame and 3/4"x5 1/2" surface facts twice under different entity names. Neither set captures the 3/4" threaded rod, 4X4 cut-as-needed, 8'-0" or the 1 1/2" / 7 1/2" section dimensions.
